archReview.notes: arch-scan archSpecific=true (rules: riscv-macro, march-flag, vlenb). Specialized RVV review against SOPHGO SG2044 (RVV 1.0, VLEN=128, vlenb=16) and Build ISA rv64...v1p0...zvl128b: all used instructions belong to base V (zve32x/zve32f) plus vfncvt.f.f.w from zvfhmin, which the patch enables via -march=rv64gcv_zfhmin_zvfhmin; hardware cpuinfo.isa already carries zfh/zfhmin/zvfhmin. vsetvl/vtype consistent (uniform e32m1, mf2 for f16 narrowing, no register-group overlap); tail-agnostic accumulators + vlmax reductions are correct; scalar<->vector boundary uses vfmv seed/extract; dispatch gating is conservative with scalar fallback retained. exp range reduction verified: r = x - n*ln2_hi - n*ln2_lo with BOTH ln2 terms scaled by the integer n via vfnmsac.vf (vd - rs1*vs2), i.e. the prior same-family critical bug (ln2_hi not scaled by k) is NOT reproduced. negate applied exactly once per vector (vfneg.v) in each of the three passes, preserving softmin = softmax(-x) semantics. No x86/ARM instructions. Only residual: no RISC-V cross toolchain available in this environment, so configure/build/runtime was not executed.

findings.evidence: diff: '+    vsum            = __riscv_vfadd_vv_f32m1(vsum, VecExp(v, vl), vl);' and '+  const float sum = __riscv_vfmv_f_s_f32m1_f32(__riscv_vfredusum_vs_f32m1_f32m1(' ; scalar reference accumulates AType sum = double with ordered += and divides in double (softmax_fwd::Map double overload), while the vector path uses f32 accumulation + unordered vfredusum + f32 division. diaglog Phase 4 explicitly flags 'vfredusum 改变 FP 结合顺序（AType=double 合同）'.
findings.suggestion: Record the FP reordering tolerance for the AType=double contract; for OType=half_t the deviation is far below FP16 resolution (~1e-3), but if bit-closer agreement is required consider vfredosum or double accumulation.

findings.evidence: diff: '+  vfloat32m1_t xc = __riscv_vfmax_vv_f32m1(' and '+      x, __riscv_vfmv_v_f_f32m1(-87.33654475f, vl), vl);' clamps x, so exp(-Inf) becomes the smallest normal (~1.175e-38) instead of exact 0 as produced by reference expf(-Inf)=0.
findings.suggestion: For OType=half_t the value underflows to 0 (no observable difference); for OType=float, add a vmerge that maps -Inf input to 0.0 if bit-exact agreement is required.

findings.evidence: diff: '+  // exp(r) on |r| <= ln2/2 via a degree-7 Horner polynomial.' ; for x in [~88.376, 88.722839] rint(x*log2e)=128 is clamped to 127 so r can reach ~ln2, outside the polynomial design interval, raising truncation error to ~6.6e-7 (~11 ULP).
findings.suggestion: softmin always has x <= 0 so this defensive branch is currently unreachable; if VecExp is reused for general exp, tighten the upper clamp or reduce r further for the clamped band.

findings.evidence: diff: '+  vint32m1_t n   = __riscv_vfcvt_x_f_v_i32m1(t, vl);  // round-to-nearest-even' ; the intrinsic uses the dynamic rounding mode frm (default RNE) rather than a hard-coded RNE.
findings.suggestion: Document the frm==RNE precondition; mxnet does not modify frm, so risk is low.

findings.evidence: diff: '+        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -march=rv64gcv_zfhmin_zvfhmin")' ; GCC/Clang honor the last -march, so appending can discard an existing richer -march (e.g. zba/zbb/zbc) set by toolchain or environment. check_*_compiler_flag only validates that the flag compiles, not that it preserves existing extensions.
findings.suggestion: Append only when no -march is already present, or gate via a detected existing value / add_compile_options with a guard.

findings.evidence: diff: '+  vbool32_t isnan = __riscv_vmfne_vv_f32m1_b32(x, x, vl);' ; the reference initializes mmax from the first element and ignores NaN via 'if (mmax < val)', which differs from IEEE maxNum vfmax when the first element is NaN; the all-NaN output coincides because the NaN propagates through vsum, but this equivalence is not pinned by tests.
findings.suggestion: Add explicit NaN / +Inf / -Inf / all-equal cases to the category-activation regression to fix the intended NaN policy.

findings.evidence: diff: '+    check_cxx_compiler_flag("-march=rv64gcv_zfhmin_zvfhmin" MXNET_RISCV_HAS_GCV_ZFHMIN)' ; CheckCXXCompilerFlag is included earlier at CMakeLists.txt:244 so the macro is available and the logic is self-consistent, but no RISC-V cross toolchain exists in this review environment so configure/build/run was not executed.
findings.suggestion: Run the blueprint regression 'agent1 patch_regression --case category-activation' and re-check perf annotate for vle32/vfneg.v/vfredmax/vfredusum/vector exp/vse16 with fsub.s@19a6680 and auipc@19a670a samples reduced or gone.
